text:
Alex Gehaz Malasusa succeeded Stephen Moshi (the question's "Stefano" appears to be a misspelling) as presiding bishop of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in Tanzania in 2017. The team note's candidates, Samson Mushemba and Erasto Kweka, don't match what I know of this office, and I can't check a current source here to confirm either way.

CONFIDENCE: 75
